present.title: Presenter
present.openWindow: Open in a new window (second display if there is one)
present.introTitle: Show Scripture on a second screen
present.introBody: Presenting starts a small web page on this computer. Open it in a browser or a new window on a projector or second display; it follows what you choose here.
present.lanOption: Also allow other devices on my local network (a TV or projector computer)
present.lanWarning: Anyone on this network who has the address can watch. The address contains a secret and travels unencrypted; share it only with the device you mean, and avoid public Wi-Fi.
present.noScreens: No screen connected yet. Open the address above in a browser, or use the buttons at the top right.
present.qrAlt: QR code for the screen address on the local network
present.nothingShown: Nothing is on the screen yet. Choose a passage and press Show on screen.
